items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: Because we used to have to play for Senator Brady Every Saturday night

ctx.x: What was the very first job you ever played? Can you remember that you got paid for it? Well, the first job

I don't know The first job Because we used to have to play for Senator Brady Every Saturday night Yeah Then he used to throw up sacks of money You know And he'd have that there This for his people out there Well we had to go pray for him every Saturday night Because he was paying all the teaching from Professor Umford And that was it So he'd come with a sack of money in each hand That's to make you a razzle for it
We were talking about Dave Bailey
